question: I want to know the name of the guy who gave Usopp the rice balls in Volume 36. He was such a nice guy (cry). Old Guy
answer: Ahh, yes. It was a lovely gesture, wasn't it? I was thanking him as I drew it. Well, he's Happa-san, a kindly old bandit-turned-carpenter. He moved there from Pucci, the town of gourmets. He's a bachelor once-divorced, so he made those rice balls by himself. Packed inside them were the Water Seven specialty, Mizu Mizu Meat, so they must have been quite good.
name: Nice Old Guy
